datasets.title: Eswatini: Acute Food Insecurity Country Data
datasets.description: The IPC Acute Food Insecurity (IPC AFI) classification provides strategically relevant information to decision makers that focuses on short-term objectives to prevent, mitigate or decrease severe food insecurity that threatens lives or livelihoods. This data has been produced by the National IPC Technical Working Groups for IPC population estimates since 2017. All national population figures are based on official country population estimates. IPC estimates are those published in country IPC reports. There is also a global dataset .. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/eswatini-acute-food-insecurity-country-data]

lineage.description: The IPC Acute Food Insecurity classification system aggregates population data from national sources and classifies populations into five phases (1-5) based on food security status. Data has been produced by Eswatini's National IPC Technical Working Group since 2017, with estimates published in country IPC reports and disaggregated by administrative area and time period.

sources.name: National IPC Technical Working Group
sources.description: Official country population estimates and IPC Acute Food Insecurity classifications produced by the national technical working group since 2017, based on the IPC Manual methodology.
